title: The Austonian Sky Residence
description: Breathtaking 42nd-floor luxury condo overlooking Lady Bird Lake and the Texas Capitol. Features floor-to-ceiling panoramic glass, custom Scavolini Italian cabinetry, marble waterfall island, private balcony, and 24/7 concierge service with world-class amenities.

title: SoCo Modern Architectural Retreat
description: Sleek contemporary custom home steps away from South Congress avenue shopping and dining. Designed with an open-concept flow, polished concrete floors, soaring cedar ceilings, private pool courtyard, and smart-home integration throughout.

title: East Austin Industrial Artist Loft
description: Authentic urban loft in the heart of the vibrant East Austin arts corridor. Boasts 14-foot exposed beam ceilings, polished aggregate floors, steel-framed windows, designer kitchen, and a private rooftop terrace overlooking the skyline.

title: Zilker Park Contemporary Villa
description: Architectural masterpiece bordering Zilker Park and Barton Springs. Highlights include expansive limestone walls, floor-to-ceiling glass sliders opening to a heated lap pool, outdoor summer kitchen, and a private primary wing with spa bath.

title: Domain Northside High-Rise Flat
description: Turnkey modern flat located directly above vibrant Domain Northside. Walk to high-end boutiques, Apple campus shuttles, and premier dining. Features quartz countertops, smart thermostat, keyless entry, and access to infinity pool and co-working club.

title: Barton Creek Hilltop Estate
description: Sprawling hilltop sanctuary in Barton Hills with breathtaking views across the Greenbelt. Boasts infinity edge pool, temperature-controlled wine cellar, 3-car motor court, detached guest casita, and unmatched privacy just 10 minutes to downtown.

title: Rainey Historic District Craftsman
description: Meticulously restored 1920s historic bungalow zoned for flexible residential/commercial luxury use. Original heart-pine flooring, wrap-around rocking chair porch, modern designer chef's kitchen, and secluded cedar-fenced backyard with fire pit.

title: Mueller Sustainable Modern Townhouse
description: LEED Platinum certified townhouse in master-planned Mueller community. Steps from Mueller Lake Park, farmers markets, and local cafes. Equipped with full solar array, electric vehicle charging outlet, high-efficiency geothermal HVAC, and private xeriscaped patio.

title: Hyde Park Historic Victorian Charm
description: Quintessential Hyde Park residence surrounded by towering pecan trees. Preserved stained glass accents, crown moldings, updated gourmet kitchen with gas range, and a detached two-story garage apartment perfect for guest suite or creative studio.

title: Clarksville Mediterranean Villa
description: Graceful Mediterranean estate tucked away on a quiet street in historic Clarksville. Enclosed central fountain courtyard, handcrafted iron railings, private wine cellar, heated saltwater plunge pool, and lush manicured grounds minutes from downtown.

title: Bouldin Creek Mid-Century Revival
description: Stunning mid-century revival home featuring floor-to-ceiling windows, natural tongue-and-groove ceilings, open layout, custom walnut millwork, and private swimming pool surrounded by mature live oaks.

title: Lake Austin Scenic Hillside Parcel
description: Rare 0.64-acre shovel-ready residential homesite with panoramic views of Lake Austin and the Hill Country. Includes fully approved architectural plans by renowned Austin modernist architect, utility hookups at property line, and private dock rights.

title: Seaholm Eco-District Waterfront Condo
description: Modern high-rise condo in Austin's iconic Seaholm Power Plant district. Directly connects to the Ann & Roy Butler Hike-and-Bike Trail and Trader Joe's. Features European finishes, gas cooking, private balcony, and 10th-floor sky deck pool.

title: South Lamar Contemporary Townhome
description: Tri-level designer townhome just off vibrant South Lamar (SoLa). Private two-car garage, primary suite on dedicated floor with double vanities, expansive rooftop terrace with downtown views, and zero HOA fees.

title: East Cesar Chavez Modern Farmhouse
description: Custom modern farmhouse located blocks from the river and East Austin's trendiest taco bars and breweries. Features board-and-batten siding, light white oak floors, gas firepit patio, and pre-wired rooftop solar system.
address: 1802 E Cesar Chavez St, Austin, TX 78702

title: Tarrytown Shaded Oak Manor
description: Timeless luxury in prestigious Tarrytown. Situated on a serene tree-canopied lot with lagoon-style pool and waterfall. Includes custom paneled study, sub-zero refrigeration, butler pantry, and primary bedroom sitting room with fireplace.

title: The Independent 'Jenga Tower' Corner Suite
description: Iconic corner residence at The Independent over Shoal Creek. Unobstructed southern and western views, motorized solar shades, Miele appliances, quartz waterfall bar, and access to two full floors of luxury amenities including cantilevered pool deck.

title: Oak Hill View Acreage Homesite
description: Full 1.0-acre estate parcel located at the gateway to the Texas Hill Country in Oak Hill, Austin. Grand native heritage live oaks, gentle slope ideal for multi-level architectural compound, and no city restrictions on private pool or guest house.
address: 6200 Old Bee Caves Rd, Austin, TX 78735

title: Holly District Lakeview Bungalow
description: Charming updated bungalow located just 1 block from Lady Bird Lake in the desirable Holly district of East Austin. Features screened cedar porch, original hardwood floors, modernized kitchen with brass fixtures, and lush private xeriscape garden.

title: Domain Luxe Corner Apartment
description: Spacious top-floor corner apartment offering serene courtyard views and high-end modern finishes. Includes dedicated covered parking space, walk-in California closets, rainfall shower, and access to state-of-the-art wellness facility.
